title: Corporate Egg-spionage
start: Talk to the Easter Bunny in the Blooming Burrow.

recommended.t: Access to the Port Sarim lodestone

rewards.t: Emotes from previous Easter events (if not already unlocked)
Access to the Intel Eggstraction activity in the Blooming Burrow

steps.t: Talk to the Easter Bunny outside their house in the Blooming Burrow. [Chat: 1 Do you have a quest for me? › Accept]
Go to the Egg Plant on the western side of the burrow and talk to either the Easter Bunny, Angus Almond, Carmilla Caramel, or Chad Berry.
Talk to the Easter Bunny just north.
Just outside of the Egg Plant, north-east of Nougat Bunny's stall, confront the Suspicious Rabbit.
Go east by passing the two bridges and then midway south (north of the Thieving icons on the map) and confront the Loitering Hare.
Go all the way south-east and confront the Odd Jackrabbit from behind.
Talk to Count Rivance outside of Gerrant's Fishy Business at the eastern wall.
Talk to the Easter Bunny. [Chat: 1 Yes!]

Talk to either Angus Almond, Carmilla Caramel, or Chad Berry. [Chat: 1 Carmilla has been replacing your gold with chocolate coins! › 2 You pay your employees overtime! › 2 You've been cooking the books! › 3 You have an almond allergy!]
